name: suggestionbox
short: MCP feedback server for reporting errors/improvements, per-agent gated.
description: Runs an MCP tools server (report_error, suggest_improvement) that posts to a bot-owner-configured Discord channel. Registers into corridor's AgentToolServerRegistry so a registered A2A agent's own tool loop (architect today) can call the same tools, gated per agent by a Components V2 toggle panel.
end_user_data_statement: This cog stores no data about Discord users: only a bot-owner-configured feedback channel, its MCP listener host/port, and a per-agent access list. Feedback reports filed by LLM agents (which can quote conversation content) are posted as messages in that channel and not stored by the cog.
install_msg: Install corridor too ([p]cog install pixel-agents-cogs corridor); it loads automatically. Starts an MCP HTTP server (127.0.0.1:8934 by default; it accepts only corridor, which holds a token minted on each load) that registered A2A agents call to post error reports and suggestions to a Discord channel. Setup (bot owner): [p]suggestionbox channel #channel, [p]suggestionbox mcp host/port, then grant agents access with [p]suggestionbox agents.
